name: The Sanctity Of Marriage
overview: Scripture reveals that marriage is a divine institution established by God for companionship and unity, as seen when God created a suitable helper for man and declared that a man shall leave his parents to unite with his wife, becoming one flesh. The sanctity of this union is underscored by the commandment against adultery and the Lord's clear disapproval of divorce, emphasizing faithfulness and commitment. Additionally, finding a wife is portrayed as a blessing and favor from the Lord, highlighting marriage as a good and honorable covenant to be cherished and protected.
